results: Default settings contain an explicit null pause and persist with the expected schema
Explicit off survives a new store instance and advances the revision
Timed pause expires without changing explicit off behavior
Corrupt or incomplete settings are preserved and never silently reset
Settings and lock symlinks cannot escape the private data directory
A dangling settings symlink is rejected rather than treated as first launch
Native commands require a valid handshake and reject malformed scalar types
Safari request metadata shares the same settings as a Chrome native session
Browser readiness needs fresh matching acknowledgments for both rules and scripts
Native framing round trips Unicode and rejects truncated or excessive payloads
Chrome registration contains only the exact extension origin and current helper
Chrome registration preserves unrelated hosts and refuses foreign ownership
Chrome updates replace only an owned registration and removal checks the current installation
Chrome registration symlinks preserve their outside target
Independent native processes serialize concurrent settings updates without lost revisions
Native host refuses an unregistered Chrome extension origin
A private fresh app heartbeat is removed only by its owning process
App promotion is atomic and refuses a destination that appeared during installation
scope: Real private files, native processes, locking, framing, shared Safari protocol, and Chrome registration. Browser acceptance is separate.
